name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private research: direct station binding on one tram lane. Native placement is unproven.
description: Revision 9 changes the direct-binding test stop to an internal single-lane tram STREET profile. Revision 8 was rejected by TF3 validation because the vanilla tram template has multiple matching transport lanes. This version supplies exactly one forward lane; it does not implement reversing or a terminus. First test remains one placement and read-only diagnostics before building a line. No overlapping reverse curves, automatic commands, train track conversion or existing station changes. Native acceptance, passenger access and network connections remain unproven. Reload the test save after replacing the files. Do not use revision 6 (0.2.2), which caused a duplicate-edge crash.
